item.tib: dam can rgya mtsho'i mchod gzhung g+ha na tsakra
item.coloph: zhes pa'ang dam can rgya mtsho'i lha gtso 'khor bcu gsum gyi skor tshogs 'khor gcig 'bul lam 'grub phyir du/ dam can rgya mtsho'i mchod gzung g+ha na tsakra zhes bya ba 'di/ shar rgyal mo rong gi nye bar g.yung drung dpal gyi gdan sa bkra shis smin grol khrod kyi char/ rang nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa rtse gcig tu phyogs pa'i sku 'bum rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba de nyid kyis nan cher bskyed nas bskul ngor/ dga' ba zhes pa shing pho stag gi lo dbyar zla ra ba dang po'i tshes gsum gyi nyin par dge sbyor thun mtshams su/ snyigs ma'i dus 'chi med thugs sras o rgyan bstan gnyis gling pa'am/ ming yang grags u rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis slob phyir ltos ma byas nas ji shar sug bris bgyis zin lags brtsams pas/ mi 'thad pa'i tho tshig sogs/ ched song na lhag pa'i lha dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs la bzod par bzhes la tshangs par rtsal du gsol/ zhes bden pa'i nus mthus sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid gsum yul rtser bsgrengs la/ rtag tu nub pa med par rgyal gyur cig/
